import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
cameras = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between price and megapixels, colored by sensor type
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=cameras, x='megapixels', y='price_usd', hue='sensor_type', style='has_video_4k', palette='viridis', s=100, alpha=0.8)

# Add title and labels
scatter.set_title('Price vs Megapixels of Cameras by Sensor Type', fontsize=16)
scatter.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=14)
scatter.set_ylabel('Price in USD', fontsize=14)

# Adjust legend
scatter.legend(title='Sensor Type / Has 4K Video', title_fontsize='13', fontsize='11', loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(1, 1))

# Save the plot as a PNG file
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
